title: Direct upload by the New York city department of environmental protection.
officialText: The New York city department of environmental protection shall upload directly to the benchmarking tool information on water use at all buildings that were equipped with automatic meter reading equipment by the New York city department of environmental protection for the entirety of the previous calendar year and that are subject to the benchmarking requirements of this article.
